66161.recognize_zh: 中倍（20x）H&E 骨髓切片，左上方大片淡粉紅色區域由大型細胞組成，細胞質豐富、帶細條紋，核小而偏心，呈片狀浸潤，即 Gaucher 細胞；右側為深紫色密集的造血細胞與數顆巨核細胞，兩者分界清楚。
features: Large polygonal to spindled cells with abundant pale eosinophilic, finely striated cytoplasm and small eccentric bland nuclei
Cells form a confluent interstitial sheet at the upper left and extend into the hematopoietic areas
Adjacent hypercellular hematopoietic marrow with granulocytic and erythroid precursors and several megakaryocytes
Bony trabeculae at the right edge and bottom
No granulomas, necrosis or atypical mitoses
66161.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine section shows hypercellular marrow with preserved trilineage hematopoiesis, including megakaryocytes. There is an extensive interstitial to sheet-like infiltrate of large histiocytic cells with abundant pale eosinophilic, finely fibrillary cytoplasm and small eccentric bland nuclei. No granulomas, necrosis or cytologic atypia are identified. Findings are consistent with marrow infiltration by Gaucher cells.

ddx.vs: Pseudo-Gaucher cells accompany CML, myeloma or mycobacterial infection, and the background disease and normal glucocerebrosidase activity separate them.
Mast cell lesions are spindled aggregates with eosinophils and fibrosis that are tryptase, CD117 and CD25 positive.
Epithelioid histiocytes form compact granulomas with multinucleated giant cells and lymphocyte cuffs, lacking striated abundant cytoplasm.

ddx.dx: Metastatic signet ring or clear cell carcinoma
ddx.vs: Carcinoma cells are cohesive, cytokeratin positive and have atypical nuclei, whereas Gaucher cells are CD68 positive with bland nuclei.

65457.recognize_zh: 中央這顆嗜中性球的細胞質布滿粗大的深紫紅色顆粒，旁邊正常淋巴球作為大小與顏色對照，顆粒明顯比一般嗜中性球粗大，這是 Alder-Reilly 包涵體。
features: Neutrophil with a lobated nucleus and cytoplasm packed with coarse dark purple-red granules
Granules uniform and evenly distributed throughout the cytoplasm
Adjacent small lymphocyte and a second lymphoid cell with pale blue cytoplasm for comparison
No toxic vacuolation or Döhle bodies
Background red cells unremarkable
65457.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a neutrophil with a lobated nucleus and cytoplasm packed with coarse, uniform, dark purple-red granules, markedly coarser than normal neutrophil granulation. An adjacent small lymphocyte and another lymphoid cell with pale blue cytoplasm are present for comparison. Toxic vacuolation and Döhle bodies are absent, and the red cells are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with Alder-Reilly inclusions in a neutrophil, suggestive of a mucopolysaccharidosis.

ddx.vs: Toxic granulation is finer and patchier, usually accompanied by vacuoles and Döhle bodies, and occurs in infection or inflammation.
Basophil granules are blue-black, variable in size, and often obscure the nucleus, whereas this cell has uniform purple-red granules with visible neutrophil lobation.
Chédiak-Higashi neutrophils contain a few giant irregular granules rather than numerous uniform coarse granules.

65393.recognize_zh: 這是兩張骨髓抹片的肉眼照：左邊骨髓瘤病人的抹片整片呈藍色，右邊健康人為紫色，藍色背景來自血清中大量副蛋白（paraprotein）吸附鹼性染料。
features: Macroscopic photograph of two stained bone marrow films side by side
Left (myeloma) film shows diffuse blue discoloration of the smear background
Right (healthy control) film shows the expected purple-violet staining
Blue tint most intense in the thicker (lower) portion of the smear
No cellular detail assessable at this magnification
65393.describe_en: Macroscopic photograph compares a Romanowsky-stained bone marrow film from a patient with multiple myeloma (left) with a film from a healthy individual (right). The myeloma film shows diffuse bluish background staining, most pronounced in the thicker part of the smear, whereas the control film stains purple. This appearance reflects increased serum protein (paraprotein) taking up the basophilic dye and correlates microscopically with a blue protein background and rouleaux. The finding is suggestive of a paraproteinemia such as plasma cell myeloma but is not specific and requires serum protein electrophoresis and marrow evaluation.

ddx.vs: Produces the same blue background, so separation requires immunofixation and marrow morphology showing lymphoplasmacytic cells rather than a plasma cell proliferation.

ddx.dx: Polyclonal hypergammaglobulinemia (chronic liver disease, HIV, autoimmune disease)
ddx.vs: Can also cause blue background and rouleaux, but electrophoresis shows a broad polyclonal increase rather than an M-spike.
Artifactual blue tint from over-buffered stain or thick smears affects control slides stained in the same run and is not accompanied by rouleaux.

65329.recognize_zh: 尿沉渣濕片中可見多片大而扁平、透明的板狀結晶，外形為平行四邊形或菱形，邊緣呈階梯狀層層堆疊並有缺角，背景有桿菌與碎屑，符合膽固醇結晶（cholesterol crystals）。
features: Large, thin, transparent flat plate-like crystals
Rhomboid to parallelogram outlines with notched corners
Stacked, stepwise concentric layering of plates
Background of rod-shaped bacteria and amorphous debris
No cells or casts evident in this field; unstained wet preparation
65329.describe_en: Unstained wet preparation of urine sediment shows numerous large, flat, transparent plate-like crystals with rhomboid to parallelogram outlines, notched corners, and stepwise stacked layers. The background contains amorphous debris and rod-shaped bacteria; no casts or cellular elements are identified in this field. Findings are consistent with cholesterol crystals; polarized microscopy and correlation with proteinuria, lipid profile, and renal function are recommended.

ddx.vs: Contrast crystals resemble cholesterol plates but occur with very high urine specific gravity after contrast exposure and dissolve with dilution.
Uric acid crystals are yellow-brown rhomboids or rosettes in acid urine and are smaller and thicker, lacking the thin stacked plates with notched corners.
Struvite forms colorless three-dimensional coffin-lid prisms in alkaline urine rather than flat layered plates.

65201.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片充滿中型母細胞，高核質比、核染色質細、細胞質少且呈藍色，無顆粒或 Auer 小體，MPO 染色陰性；流式顯示母細胞同時表現 T 系（CD7 強、胞質 CD3）與 B 系（CD19 強、CD22、胞質 CD79a）標記，屬 T/B 混合表型急性白血病。
features: Bone marrow aspirate largely replaced by medium-sized blasts with high N:C ratio (A)
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with fine chromatin and occasional small nucleoli
Scant agranular basophilic cytoplasm without Auer rods
Cytochemical MPO negative in blasts; only a residual myeloid cell shows granular positivity (B)
Flow: blasts (red) coexpress CD19, CD22, cytoplasmic CD79a with bright CD7 and cytoplasmic CD3; partial TdT, CD99, CD38; CD34-, MPO-, surface CD3- (C-J)
65201.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows marked replacement by medium-sized blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, fine chromatin and scant agranular basophilic cytoplasm; Auer rods are not seen. Cytochemical myeloperoxidase is negative in the blasts. Flow cytometry shows that the blasts express bright CD7, cytoplasmic CD3, dim CD5, strong CD19, CD22 and cytoplasmic CD79a, with partial TdT and CD99, CD38 positivity, and lack CD34, surface CD3 and MPO. Findings are consistent with mixed-phenotype acute leukemia, T/B type.

ddx.vs: Isolated weak CD79a or CD19 is allowed in T-ALL, but strong CD19 with CD22 and CD79a here fulfills B-lineage assignment criteria.
CD7 is a common aberrancy in B-ALL, but cytoplasmic CD3 (at T-cell intensity) establishes T-lineage and is not an aberrant B-ALL marker.
B/myeloid MPAL requires MPO or monocytic differentiation, whereas these blasts are MPO-negative by cytochemistry and flow.
ETP-ALL expresses stem/myeloid markers (CD34, CD117, CD13/33) with CD1a/CD8 negativity and lacks strong B-lineage antigens.

65073.recognize_zh: 內視鏡可見胃竇無蒂息肉；低倍 H&E 顯示黏膜下緊密排列、背靠背的結節狀淋巴濾泡，高倍以小型淋巴球為主；CD20 與 CD10 陽性的腫瘤濾泡同時表現 BCL-2，符合低惡度濾泡性淋巴瘤而非反應性濾泡。
features: Endoscopic sessile polypoid lesion in the gastric antrum
Low power: closely packed, back-to-back nodular follicles expanding the mucosa/submucosa with attenuated mantle zones
High power: monotonous small lymphoid cells beneath gastric glands without obvious tingible-body macrophages
CD20 and CD10 strongly positive throughout the neoplastic follicles
BCL-2 strongly positive within the follicles (inappropriate germinal center BCL-2 expression)
65073.describe_en: Endoscopy shows a sessile polyp in the gastric antrum. The resected polyp contains a nodular lymphoid proliferation of closely packed, back-to-back follicles with attenuated mantle zones, composed predominantly of small lymphoid cells beneath the gastric mucosa. The follicles are strongly positive for CD20 and CD10 and show diffuse BCL-2 coexpression. Findings are consistent with low-grade follicular lymphoma, follicular pattern, involving the stomach.

ddx.vs: MALT lymphoma shows marginal zone/monocytoid cells with lymphoepithelial lesions and follicular colonization, and is CD10- and BCL6-negative.
Reactive germinal centers are polarized with tingible-body macrophages and are BCL-2 negative.
MCL shows nodules of CD5+/cyclin D1+ cells that are CD10-negative.
Duodenal-type FL involves small bowel mucosa as small polyps; gastric involvement by a mass lesion favors systemic/conventional FL requiring staging.

65073.stain: Endoscopic photo; H&E; IHC: CD20, CD10, BCL-2

65137.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片左側嗜中性白血球的細胞質中有一顆小而圓、深紫色、邊界清楚的包涵物，顏色與細胞核相同，像紅血球的 Howell-Jolly body；右側嗜中性球核分葉較少、未見明確包涵物。
features: Left neutrophil with a single small, round, dense dark purple cytoplasmic inclusion near the nucleus
Inclusion is sharply demarcated and matches nuclear chromatin in color
Both neutrophils have hypolobated band-like or C-shaped nuclei with clumped chromatin
Pale pink cytoplasm without toxic granulation or Dohle bodies
Background crenated red cells (echinocytes, likely artifactual), scattered red cell fragments and platelets
65137.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two neutrophils with hypolobated, band-like nuclei and clumped chromatin. The neutrophil on the left contains a single small, round, sharply circumscribed dark purple inclusion in the cytoplasm adjacent to the nucleus, resembling a Howell-Jolly body, while the neutrophil on the right lacks a definite inclusion. No toxic granulation or Dohle bodies are seen. The background red cells are largely crenated, with occasional fragments and adequate platelets. Findings are consistent with a Howell-Jolly body-like inclusion in a neutrophil, a finding described with immunosuppressive agents, chemotherapy and HIV infection.

ddx.vs: A platelet shows a granular purple center with pale hyalomere and often lies partly outside the cell outline, whereas this inclusion is uniformly dense and fully intracytoplasmic.
Dohle bodies are pale blue-grey and irregular at the cytoplasmic periphery rather than a dark purple round dot.

ddx.dx: Detached nuclear lobe in pseudo-Pelger or apoptotic neutrophil
ddx.vs: A detached lobe is larger with lobe-like chromatin texture, whereas this inclusion is a tiny homogeneous sphere.

64881.recognize_zh: 九格拼圖可見雙葉、染色質粗塊且顆粒稀少的假 Pelger-Huët 嗜中性球、核圓而染色質濃縮的非分葉嗜中性球、胞質淡而幾乎無顆粒的細胞，以及未成熟骨髓系細胞，背景紅血球有大球性，這些嗜中性球發育不良線索支持骨髓發育不良。
features: Bilobed neutrophils with coarsely clumped chromatin and spectacle-like lobes (pseudo-Pelger-Huët anomaly)
Non-lobed neutrophil with a round, condensed nucleus
Hypogranular to agranular neutrophil cytoplasm in several cells
Immature myeloid cells including a large granulated promyelocyte/myelocyte and metamyelocytes
Cell with coarse dark granules partially obscuring the nucleus, possibly basophil or abnormal granulation
Background macrocytes and anisocytosis
64881.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear montage shows dysplastic granulocytes, including bilobed and non-lobed neutrophils with coarsely condensed chromatin (pseudo-Pelger-Huët forms) and neutrophils with hypogranular cytoplasm. Circulating immature myeloid cells, including promyelocytes or myelocytes and metamyelocytes, are present, and the red cells show macrocytosis and anisocytosis. Nucleated red cells are not clearly identified in these panels. Findings are suggestive of a myelodysplastic neoplasm; bone marrow examination with blast enumeration and cytogenetics is required for diagnosis.

ddx.vs: Inherited Pelger-Huët affects nearly all neutrophils with normal granulation and normal blood counts, without macrocytosis or other dysplasia.
Morphology overlaps; history of drugs such as mycophenolate, valproate or taxanes, or HIV infection, and transient changes favor a secondary cause.
Megaloblastic anemia shows hypersegmented rather than hyposegmented neutrophils and oval macrocytes, with low vitamin levels.
CMML has persistent absolute monocytosis of at least 0.5 x 10^9/L, which is not evident here.

64561.recognize_zh: 同一視野出現多個嗜酸性球，部分顆粒稀疏、細胞質呈淡藍空白區，並夾雜圓核、顆粒粗大的嗜酸性骨髓細胞，周邊血出現嗜酸性前驅細胞與低顆粒化，提示腫瘤性嗜酸性球增多。
features: Increased eosinophils in a single field
Hypogranular eosinophils with sparse granules and patchy clear cytoplasm
Eosinophilic myelocyte with a large round nucleus and coarse eosinophilic granules (center)
Immature eosinophil with a bilobed nucleus and admixed dark purple-blue granules (upper right)
Eosinophils with abnormal nuclear segmentation (hyperlobated, upper left)
Background red cells in rouleaux-like stacks; platelets present
64561.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked eosinophilia with morphologic abnormalities. Several eosinophils are hypogranular with sparse granules and areas of cytoplasmic clearing, and some show abnormal nuclear lobation. Circulating eosinophil precursors are present, including an eosinophilic myelocyte with a round nucleus and an immature form with admixed dark basophilic granules. Findings are suggestive of a myeloid neoplasm with eosinophilia; in the appropriate context, testing for PDGFRA, PDGFRB, FGFR1, JAK2, and FLT3 rearrangements is indicated.

ddx.vs: Reactive eosinophils are usually mature and well granulated without circulating precursors, although morphology alone cannot fully exclude a clonal process.
CEL lacks the defining tyrosine kinase gene rearrangements and is separated by FISH/molecular testing, not morphology.
SM shows spindled CD25+ tryptase+ mast cell aggregates in marrow and KIT D816V mutation.
This is driven by an aberrant T-cell clone detected by flow cytometry, with morphologically unremarkable eosinophils.

64433.recognize_zh: 胃黏膜固有層至黏膜下層被小至中型淋巴細胞密集浸潤，CD20 陽性，其間散布少數 CD30 陽性的大型細胞，EBER 原位雜交可見大量陽性核；配合長期 methotrexate 免疫抑制病史，符合 EBV 陽性黏膜皮膚潰瘍（EBVMCU）。
features: Dense lymphoid infiltrate expanding gastric lamina propria and displacing glands (panel A)
Polymorphous small to medium lymphoid cells with irregular nuclei admixed with scattered larger cells (panel B)
CD20 highlights numerous B cells, including a heavy band of positive cells (panels C, D)
Scattered large CD30-positive cells with membranous/Golgi staining (panel E, arrow)
EBER ISH shows numerous positive nuclei of variable size (panel F)
Ulcer base and circumscription are not fully assessable in these panels
64433.describe_en: Gastric biopsies show a dense lymphoid infiltrate in the lamina propria and submucosa composed of small to medium-sized lymphoid cells with admixed scattered large atypical cells. CD20 highlights a predominant B-cell population, and CD30 stains occasional large cells. EBER in situ hybridization shows numerous EBV-positive cells of varying size. In an immunosuppressed patient on methotrexate, with localized ulcerative disease and no systemic involvement on PET/CT, findings are consistent with EBV-positive mucocutaneous ulcer of the stomach.

ddx.dx: EBV-positive diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, NOS
ddx.vs: EBV+ DLBCL forms sheets of large cells with mass-forming or systemic disease, whereas EBVMCU is a sharply circumscribed ulcer with a polymorphous infiltrate and a rim of T cells.
cHL shows CD15+/CD30+ Hodgkin cells with loss of CD20 and a nodal presentation, while the large cells here retain B-cell program in a mucosal ulcer.
MALT lymphoma consists of monotonous small centrocyte-like B cells with lymphoepithelial lesions and is EBER-negative.

ddx.dx: Reactive ulcer with lymphoid hyperplasia (e.g. Helicobacter gastritis)
ddx.vs: Reactive infiltrates contain only rare EBER+ cells and lack large atypical CD30+ immunoblasts in such numbers.

64433.stain: H&E; IHC: CD20, CD30; ISH: EBER

64177.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中一顆淋巴樣細胞，細胞核有一道明顯的裂隙（cleft）呈腎形／凹陷，染色質中度凝集，周圍有中等量淡藍色細胞質；這是 Waldenström 巨球蛋白血症（淋巴漿細胞淋巴瘤）周邊循環的異常淋巴細胞之一，但形態本身不具特異性。
features: Single small-to-medium lymphoid cell slightly larger than a normal lymphocyte
Nucleus with a deep cleft/notch giving a folded contour
Moderately condensed chromatin without conspicuous nucleoli
Moderate rim of pale blue agranular cytoplasm
Background red cells with some overlap; a platelet present
64177.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows an atypical small-to-medium lymphoid cell with a deeply cleaved nucleus, moderately condensed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli, and a moderate rim of pale blue cytoplasm. Background red cells are unremarkable in this field, and prominent rouleaux is not evident here. The cell is compatible with a circulating lymphoma cell; in the clinical context of IgM paraproteinemia and MYD88 L265P mutation, findings are consistent with peripheral blood involvement by lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma.

ddx.vs: FL cells are small with scant cytoplasm and sharp nuclear clefts, CD10+/BCL2+, whereas LPL cells often show plasmacytoid cytoplasm and MYD88 L265P.
MCL cells have irregular nuclei but are cyclin D1/SOX11-positive with t(11;14), which requires ancillary testing.
Reactive lymphocytes have abundant cytoplasm scalloping around red cells and a heterogeneous population, not a clonal B-cell population.
SMZL cells may show villous projections and plasmacytoid features; separation from LPL relies on MYD88 status, IgM paraprotein, and marrow pattern.

64113.recognize_zh: 畫面中央一個大型巨噬細胞（histiocyte），細胞質內可見多個被吞噬、仍保有分葉核的顆粒球，外圍有空泡狀吞噬泡（phagocytic vacuole）包覆，還有一團粉紅色被消化中的物質，這就是噬血現象（hemophagocytosis）。
features: Single large macrophage with abundant pale grey-blue, vacuolated cytoplasm
Several intact engulfed granulocytes with clumped, lobulated nuclei, each within a clear phagocytic vacuole
Amorphous eosinophilic/pink ingested material consistent with a partially digested cell
Macrophage's own nucleus is obscured by the ingested cells
Background of numerous erythrocytes, a small orthochromatic normoblast/lymphocyte, and marrow particle-poor spread
64113.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a hemodilute background of red cells with scattered hematopoietic cells. At high power, a large macrophage contains multiple engulfed granulocytes with lobulated, pyknotic nuclei, each surrounded by a clear phagocytic vacuole, as well as amorphous eosinophilic material consistent with partially digested cellular debris. Findings show hemophagocytosis, which in the appropriate clinical and laboratory context (HLH-2004 criteria) is suggestive of hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis; hemophagocytosis alone is neither sensitive nor specific for HLH.

ddx.dx: Reactive hemophagocytosis after transfusion, infection or chemotherapy
ddx.vs: Isolated hemophagocytic macrophages are morphologically identical and are common after transfusion or sepsis, so HLH requires clinical/laboratory criteria (fever, cytopenias, ferritin, sCD25, triglycerides/fibrinogen).

ddx.dx: Macrophage with apoptotic bodies (tingible body macrophage)
ddx.vs: Tingible body macrophages contain small dense round nuclear debris rather than intact recognizable cells with lobulated nuclei in vacuoles.

ddx.dx: Emperipolesis in megakaryocytes or Rosai-Dorfman histiocytes
ddx.vs: In emperipolesis the intact cells pass through the cytoplasm without degradation, whereas here the host is a macrophage and ingested material shows digestion.

ddx.dx: Erythrophagocytosis in immune hemolytic anemia or malignancy-associated HLH
ddx.vs: Morphology cannot separate the trigger; a search for lymphoma (especially T/NK) and infections (EBV) is needed.

64049.recognize_zh: 中央一顆大型巨噬細胞（macrophage），偏心核旁的淡藍色胞質內包著數顆完整紅血球輪廓與多個小紫色顆粒（被吞噬的血小板或核碎片），這就是噬血現象（hemophagocytosis）。
features: Large macrophage with abundant pale blue-grey, vacuolated cytoplasm and irregular ruffled border
Single eccentric oval nucleus with open chromatin
Several engulfed red cells visible as pale round outlines within cytoplasmic vacuoles
Multiple small dense purple bodies in the cytoplasm consistent with phagocytosed platelets or nuclear debris
Background of bone marrow aspirate red cells with a nearby immature myeloid cell
64049.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (Romanowsky stain, high power) shows a large macrophage with abundant, vacuolated, pale blue cytoplasm and an eccentric oval nucleus. Its cytoplasm contains several intact engulfed red cells and multiple small dense purple bodies consistent with phagocytosed platelets and/or nuclear debris. The surrounding field contains red cells and occasional hematopoietic cells. Findings demonstrate hemophagocytosis, which in the appropriate clinical and laboratory setting supports hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis; hemophagocytosis alone is neither sensitive nor specific for HLH.

ddx.vs: Occasional hemophagocytic macrophages occur after transfusion, sepsis or marrow injury, so HLH requires HLH-2004 criteria (fever, cytopenias, ferritin, triglycerides/fibrinogen, sCD25) rather than morphology alone.

ddx.dx: Macrophage with ingested debris (tingible body macrophage)
ddx.vs: Tingible body macrophages contain apoptotic nuclear debris without intact engulfed red cells or platelets.
Storage histiocytes have striated or granular sea-blue cytoplasm filled with lipid rather than discrete phagocytosed blood cells.

ddx.dx: Malignant histiocytic or tumor cell with emperipolesis
ddx.vs: Emperipolesis (e.g., Rosai-Dorfman, megakaryocytes) shows intact living lymphocytes or cells passing through the cytoplasm rather than degraded red cells and platelets in a bland macrophage.

63729.recognize_zh: 視野中的嗜中性球胞質布滿粗大、深紫色的顆粒（毒性顆粒，toxic granulation），其中幾顆還有清楚的圓形空泡（vacuolation），分葉核型態正常，這組合提示感染或敗血症等發炎反應。
features: Segmented and band neutrophils with coarse, dark purple-violet cytoplasmic granules (toxic granulation)
Distinct punched-out cytoplasmic vacuoles in several neutrophils
Nuclear segmentation otherwise normal; no Döhle bodies clearly resolved
Detached granular cytoplasmic fragment/platelet-sized granular body in the field
Background red cells with some crenated forms (likely drying artifact)
63729.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows neutrophils with coarse, dark purple-violet cytoplasmic granulation, consistent with toxic granulation, and several contain discrete cytoplasmic vacuoles. Nuclear segmentation is unremarkable and Döhle bodies are not definitively seen. A detached granular cytoplasmic fragment is also present, and occasional crenated red cells likely reflect artifact. Findings are consistent with toxic changes of neutrophils, as seen in bacterial infection, sepsis, inflammation or G-CSF therapy.

ddx.vs: Alder-Reilly granules are large dark inclusions present in all leukocytes including lymphocytes and monocytes, without vacuolation or a clinical infection.
Chediak-Higashi shows few giant fused grey-purple granules rather than numerous fine-to-coarse dark granules.
Storage artifact produces vacuoles with pyknotic or degenerating nuclei but not true coarse toxic granulation.
Promyelocytes have round nuclei with nucleoli and azurophilic granules, not segmented mature nuclei.

63665.recognize_zh: 淋巴球中等大小，核圓至卵圓、染色質細緻疏鬆，細胞質豐富、呈淡灰藍色，邊緣一圈細絲狀、毛茸茸的突起（hairy projections），符合毛狀細胞（hairy cell）。
features: Medium-sized lymphoid cells (about two red cell diameters) with low to moderate N:C ratio
Round to oval nuclei with finely stippled, loosely clumped chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous
Abundant pale gray-blue agranular cytoplasm with circumferential fine hair-like projections and ill-defined borders
One smaller lymphocyte with denser chromatin and only short projections
Nucleated red cell at the bottom; background red cells with occasional crenation
63665.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows an increase in medium-sized lymphoid cells with round to oval nuclei, finely stippled chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli, and abundant pale gray-blue cytoplasm with circumferential fine hair-like cytoplasmic projections. A nucleated red cell is present in the field. No cytoplasmic granules or prominent nucleoli are seen. Findings are suggestive of hairy cell leukemia; confirmation by flow cytometry (CD11c, CD25, CD103, CD123) and bone marrow biopsy with annexin A1 and BRAF V600E studies is recommended.

ddx.vs: HCL-variant cells have a prominent central nucleolus and are CD25 and CD123 negative.
SMZL cells have more condensed chromatin and short polar rather than circumferential villi, and are CD103 negative.
Monocytes are larger with folded nuclei and gray cytoplasm containing fine granules and vacuoles, and are CD14 positive.

ddx.dx: Splenic diffuse red pulp small B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: SDRPL cells show broad-based polar villi and are annexin A1 and usually CD25 negative.

63601.recognize_zh: 箭頭指的巨大細胞有四個分開的圓形核、染色質呈車輪狀、胞質深藍且有少量小空泡，周圍還有多顆單核漿細胞樣細胞，符合多發性骨髓瘤中的多核漿細胞。
features: Giant cell with four separate, round, similarly sized nuclei
Nuclei with coarse clumped chromatin and indistinct nucleoli
Abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm with a few small clear vacuoles and a subtle paler central zone
Irregular cell border; no cytoplasmic granules
Surrounding mononuclear cells with eccentric nuclei and basophilic cytoplasm (plasma cells) plus maturing myeloid cells and RBCs
63601.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (May-Grünwald-Giemsa) shows a very large multinucleated cell with four discrete round nuclei, clumped chromatin, and abundant deeply basophilic, focally vacuolated cytoplasm lacking azurophilic granules. Several adjacent mononuclear cells show eccentric nuclei and basophilic cytoplasm, consistent with plasma cells, admixed with maturing granulocytes. The deep blue agranular cytoplasm and nuclear features favor a plasma cell over an osteoclast or megakaryocyte. Findings are consistent with a multinucleated neoplastic plasma cell in plasma cell myeloma.

ddx.vs: Osteoclasts have many (often >5) uniform oval nuclei with visible nucleoli set in abundant pink-lavender, finely granular cytoplasm, whereas this cell has few nuclei and intensely basophilic plasma-cell-type cytoplasm.
Megakaryocytes have abundant granular pink cytoplasm and lobulated or 'pawn-ball' nuclei rather than deep blue agranular cytoplasm.

ddx.dx: Reed-Sternberg-like or metastatic tumor giant cell
ddx.vs: Tumor giant cells lack the plasma cell context and are CD138/light-chain negative, with large prominent nucleoli.

63537.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指的淋巴球比一般小淋巴球大，細胞質豐富、淡藍透明，內含數顆紅紫色嗜天青顆粒（azurophilic granules），細胞邊緣受紅血球擠壓呈波浪狀，就是大顆粒淋巴球（large granular lymphocyte）。
features: Large lymphocyte (arrow) with a moderate-to-low N:C ratio and abundant pale blue cytoplasm
Several fine to coarse azurophilic (reddish-purple) cytoplasmic granules
Round to slightly oval nucleus with condensed, clumped chromatin and no visible nucleolus
Undulating cytoplasmic margins indented by adjacent red cells
Other cells: a small mature lymphocyte with scant cytoplasm, a segmented neutrophil and a smudged/degenerated cell; normocytic red cells
63537.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a large granular lymphocyte (arrow) with a round nucleus, condensed chromatin, abundant pale blue cytoplasm containing scattered azurophilic granules and undulating margins molded by adjacent red cells. A small mature lymphocyte, a segmented neutrophil and a degenerated cell are also present; red cells are unremarkable. A single LGL is morphologically indistinguishable from a normal or reactive LGL, so diagnosis requires a sustained absolute LGL count, flow cytometry (CD3+, CD8+, CD57+, CD16+) and TCR gene rearrangement or STAT3 mutation studies. In the stated clinical context, findings are consistent with T-cell large granular lymphocytic leukemia.

ddx.dx: Reactive large granular lymphocytosis (viral infection, post-transplant)
ddx.vs: Reactive LGLs look identical morphologically; transient counts, polyclonal TCR and absence of STAT3 mutation distinguish them.

ddx.dx: Chronic lymphoproliferative disorder of NK cells
ddx.vs: NK-LGLs are morphologically similar but are surface CD3 negative, CD16/CD56 positive and lack clonal TCR rearrangement.
Reactive lymphocytes are larger with deeply basophilic cytoplasm at the periphery, looser chromatin and usually lack discrete azurophilic granules.
Hairy cells have circumferential fine hair-like projections, oval or bean-shaped nuclei with spongy chromatin, and lack azurophilic granules.

63345.recognize_zh: 嗜中性球布滿粗大毒性顆粒，胞質內可見兩處不規則的藍綠色折光包涵體與小空泡，背景紅血球呈鋸齒狀；看到這種藍綠色結晶就要聯想到重症 COVID-19 合併肝衰竭。
features: Neutrophil with irregular, partly segmented nucleus
Coarse toxic granulation throughout the cytoplasm
Two discrete irregular blue-green refractile cytoplasmic inclusions
Cytoplasmic vacuolization near the inclusions
Background crenated red cells (echinocytes)
Low-resolution, color-cast image limits fine detail
63345.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a neutrophil with an irregular, partially segmented nucleus, coarse toxic granulation and cytoplasmic vacuolization. Two irregular, refractile blue-green inclusions are present in the cytoplasm. Background red cells are crenated. Findings are consistent with blue-green neutrophilic inclusions ('green crystals of death') in a critically ill patient, a marker of acute hepatic injury and poor prognosis.

ddx.vs: Döhle bodies are pale gray-blue, homogeneous, non-refractile patches at the cytoplasmic periphery.
Bacteria and yeasts have regular shapes and basophilic staining rather than irregular green refractile crystals.

ddx.dx: Hemosiderin or malarial pigment in neutrophils
ddx.vs: Hemozoin is brown-black and hemosiderin is Prussian blue-positive, unlike the green lipofuscin-like crystals.

63281.recognize_zh: G 顯帶核型圖中，第 5、7、16、17 號染色體各只剩一條（箭頭），另有數條無法辨認的標記染色體（markers），屬於複雜核型（complex karyotype），其中 -5、-7 為定義 AML-MRC 的細胞遺傳異常。
features: G-banded karyogram arranged by chromosome pair with a separate row for marker chromosomes
Single copies (monosomy or structural loss) of chromosomes 5, 7, 16 and 17, indicated by arrows
Several unidentifiable marker chromosomes shown at lower right
Sex chromosomes shown as one larger and one smaller chromosome, consistent with XY
Low banding resolution and fuzzy chromosome morphology typical of malignant marrow metaphases
63281.describe_en: This figure is a G-banded karyogram from a bone marrow metaphase. It shows loss of one homolog of chromosomes 5, 7, 16 and 17 (arrows) together with multiple unidentified marker chromosomes, which likely carry the missing material in rearranged form; sex chromosomes appear to be XY. Band resolution is low, so structural rearrangements cannot be characterized further from this image. The findings represent a complex karyotype (three or more abnormalities) including -5/5q and -7/7q abnormalities, which are myelodysplasia-related cytogenetic abnormalities and support classification as acute myeloid leukemia with myelodysplasia-related changes; loss of 17p is frequently associated with TP53 mutation and adverse prognosis.

62897.recognize_zh: 脂肪為主的低細胞性骨髓切片中，許多間質內小型細胞呈棕色核染（Cyclin D1 核陽性），散布在脂肪細胞之間、部分成小群，與藍色的陰性造血細胞交錯，符合毛細胞白血病浸潤。
features: Hypocellular, fat-predominant marrow
Numerous small to medium cells with brown nuclear staining distributed interstitially between adipocytes, singly and in loose clusters
Positive nuclei round to oval, of variable intensity
Interspersed negative (hematoxylin blue) hematopoietic cells, including small clusters
No paratrabecular or nodular aggregates in this field
62897.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain on a hypocellular, fat-rich bone marrow core biopsy shows numerous small to medium-sized cells with nuclear positivity for cyclin D1, distributed singly and in loose clusters in an interstitial pattern between adipocytes. Negative hematopoietic cells, including erythroid clusters, are interspersed. The interstitial distribution and widely spaced cells are characteristic of hairy cell leukemia. Findings are consistent with involvement by hairy cell leukemia; confirmation with CD20, annexin A1, TRAP/CD123 and BRAF V600E is recommended.

ddx.vs: MCL shows strong, uniform cyclin D1 with SOX11 positivity and paratrabecular/nodular aggregates of CD5+ cells, whereas HCL has weak-to-moderate cyclin D1 in an interstitial CD5-, annexin A1+ infiltrate.

ddx.dx: Hairy cell leukemia variant / splenic B-cell lymphoma with prominent nucleoli
ddx.vs: HCL variant is annexin A1-, CD25-, BRAF wild-type and usually cyclin D1 negative.
SMZL has an intrasinusoidal and nodular pattern and is cyclin D1 and annexin A1 negative.
These lack a CD20+ cyclin D1+ lymphoid infiltrate between the fat cells.

62961.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中多個嗜中性球核只有兩葉（呈眼鏡狀或花生狀），染色質粗塊狀濃縮，細胞質淡染且顆粒明顯減少；只有部分嗜中性球受影響，搭配全血球減少，屬於假性 Pelger-Huët 變化（常見於 MDS）。
features: Neutrophils with bilobed (spectacle/pince-nez or peanut-shaped) nuclei
Coarsely clumped, condensed nuclear chromatin
Pale cytoplasm with markedly reduced to absent granules (hypogranulation)
Only a subset of neutrophils affected; a small lymphocyte and platelets present for size comparison
Red cells largely normocytic without prominent poikilocytosis
62961.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows neutrophils with bilobed, spectacle- to peanut-shaped nuclei and coarsely clumped chromatin. The cytoplasm of these cells is pale and hypogranular. The change affects a subset of neutrophils, and platelets and a small lymphocyte are present for comparison. In a patient with pancytopenia and no relevant drug exposure or infection, findings are consistent with pseudo-Pelger-Huët (acquired pelgeroid) change, suggestive of dysgranulopoiesis in a myelodysplastic neoplasm; bone marrow examination with cytogenetics is warranted.

ddx.vs: The inherited LBR anomaly affects nearly all neutrophils with normal granulation and normal blood counts, whereas pseudo-Pelger change involves a subset with hypogranulation and cytopenias.

ddx.dx: Drug-induced pelgeroid change (e.g. mycophenolate, valproate, taxanes)
ddx.vs: Morphology is similar; the history of exposure and reversal after withdrawal distinguish it.
Bands have a continuous horseshoe-shaped nucleus with finer chromatin and normal granules, not two discrete condensed lobes.

ddx.dx: Eosinophils or basophils with bilobed nuclei
ddx.vs: Eosinophils are bilobed but have abundant orange granules, whereas these cells are agranular.

62833.recognize_zh: 拼圖 A 為肉眼可見整片深紫色的骨髓抹片；B 與 D 高倍下背景為均質紫紅色的無定形壞死物質，細胞輪廓模糊，只剩少數固縮、深染的核（箭頭），紅血球呈皺縮鬼影狀，可辨認的造血細胞極少——這種「染色過深、細胞無法判讀」的樣式是骨髓壞死（bone marrow necrosis）的線索。
features: Composite: gross slide (A) with an intensely dark purple, thick aspirate smear
High power (B): diffuse amorphous purple-eosinophilic proteinaceous background obscuring cellular detail
Scattered cells with pyknotic, hyperchromatic nuclei and smudged, poorly defined cytoplasm (arrows); few recognizable hematopoietic cells
Red cells appear crenated and ghost-like with refractile outlines
Low-power panel (C) with pale, poorly preserved smear showing clumped red cells and granular debris
Panel D: similar necrotic background with a degenerating cell with fragmented/pyknotic nucleus (arrow)
62833.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smears are grossly dark purple, and microscopically show an amorphous, granular purple-eosinophilic background in which cellular outlines are indistinct. Only scattered degenerating cells with pyknotic or fragmented hyperchromatic nuclei and smudged cytoplasm are seen, with crenated ghost-like red cells and no evaluable hematopoietic maturation. Viable cells are too few for a morphologic differential or flow cytometry, and a trephine biopsy is required to identify the underlying cause. Findings are consistent with bone marrow necrosis, which in this patient was associated with a plasma cell neoplasm.

ddx.dx: Poor smear preparation or overstaining artifact
ddx.vs: Thick or overstained smears still show intact cell membranes and recognizable maturation in thinner areas, whereas necrosis shows pyknosis and amorphous eosinophilic debris throughout.
Gelatinous transformation shows pale pink-purple extracellular mucopolysaccharide with hypocellularity but preserved, non-pyknotic residual cells.
Treatment effect produces hypocellularity with edema and ghost cells but in a known treatment setting, and the biopsy shows stromal preservation.
Morphology cannot distinguish the underlying cause of necrosis; viable-rim biopsy histology and immunohistochemistry are needed.

62769.recognize_zh: 手指蚊蟲叮咬處形成出血性水泡並轉為黑色壞死潰瘍；皮膚切片可見真皮至皮下血管與附屬器周圍密集的不典型淋巴球浸潤，免疫染色瀰漫陽性，符合EBV相關NK細胞增生之嚴重蚊蟲叮咬過敏。
features: Clinical photograph: hemorrhagic bullae evolving to dark necrotic ulcers at bite sites on the fingers (A)
Skin punch biopsy with epidermal necrosis/ulceration and a dermal-subcutaneous infiltrate at low power (B)
Dense angiocentric/periadnexal infiltrate of small to medium atypical lymphoid cells with irregular hyperchromatic nuclei (C)
Strong diffuse immunostaining of the perivascular infiltrate (D) and nuclear-pattern staining of many infiltrating cells (E)
Scattered nuclear positivity in a subset of cells, likely proliferation marker (F); markers not labeled in the figure
62769.describe_en: Clinical images show hemorrhagic bullae with central necrotic eschar on the fingers at sites of insect bites. The skin biopsy shows an ulcerated epidermis overlying a dense dermal and subcutaneous infiltrate centered on vessels and adnexa. The infiltrate is composed of small to medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells with irregular hyperchromatic nuclei, and immunostains show diffuse strong reactivity in the infiltrate with nuclear staining of many cells (antibodies not labeled in the figure). In the clinical setting of severe mosquito bite reactions, findings are consistent with severe mosquito bite allergy, an EBV-positive NK-cell lymphoproliferative disorder; CD56, cytotoxic markers and EBER in situ hybridization are required for confirmation.

ddx.vs: ENKTL forms large destructive masses with marked angiodestruction and systemic disease, rather than a localized bite-induced necrotic reaction, although both are EBER+ CD56+.
HV-LPD presents with vesiculopapules on sun-exposed face and extremities, usually with EBV+ T cells, rather than lesions confined to insect bite sites.
Reactive bite reactions contain abundant eosinophils with mixed small lymphocytes and lack EBER-positive atypical NK cells.
LyP shows scattered large CD30-positive atypical cells and is EBV negative.

62769.stain: Clinical photo; H&E; IHC (markers not labeled)

62705.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中可見多個大小不一的原始細胞：部分核質比高、染色質細緻、胞質少而深藍，另有一個較大細胞具摺疊核與較豐富、淡藍色帶細顆粒的胞質；成熟中性球稀少，型態上呈現兩種外觀的原始細胞，需流式證實為 B/骨髓系混合表型急性白血病。
features: Medium to large blasts with high N:C ratio, round to indented nuclei and fine chromatin
Scant to moderate, deeply basophilic agranular cytoplasm in the smaller blasts, some with a pale perinuclear zone
One larger blast with a folded/indented nucleus and more abundant pale blue cytoplasm with a frayed border and faint granularity, suggesting myeloid/monocytoid features
No Auer rods identified
Rare mature neutrophil and red cells with occasional crenated forms
62705.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous blasts of variable size. Most have high N:C ratio, round to indented nuclei with fine chromatin and scant, deeply basophilic agranular cytoplasm, while a larger blast has a folded nucleus and more abundant pale blue cytoplasm with a frayed border, suggesting a second, myeloid-appearing population. No Auer rods are seen, and mature neutrophils are sparse. Morphology alone cannot assign lineage, but the heterogeneous blast appearance is in keeping with a biphenotypic process; together with flow cytometry the findings are consistent with mixed phenotype acute leukemia, B/myeloid.

ddx.vs: Contains blasts plus promonocytes/monocytes with nonspecific esterase positivity but no B-lineage commitment markers on the blasts.
Blasts are more uniform and lack MPO expression or monocytic differentiation by flow cytometry and cytochemistry.

ddx.dx: AML with BCR::ABL1 or KMT2A rearrangement expressing aberrant CD19
ddx.vs: Aberrant CD19 alone is insufficient for B-lineage; MPAL requires strong CD19 with CD79a, cCD22 or CD10, and defining genetic lesions must be excluded or classified first.

ddx.dx: Lineage-switched or bilineal leukemia after therapy
ddx.vs: Distinguished by clinical history and demonstration of separate populations over time, not by morphology.

62641.recognize_zh: 這是 PNH 高靈敏度流式細胞分析的門控圖：以 CD15 對側向散射（SS）區分 CD15 強陽性、高 SS 的顆粒球（藍）、低 SS 的單核球（紅）與淋巴球（綠），之後再分別評估各族群的 FLAER 與 GPI 錨定抗原。
features: Dot plot of CD15-PC5 (x) versus side scatter (y) gated on singlets
Granulocyte gate (blue): bright CD15 with intermediate-to-high side scatter, the dominant population
Monocyte gate (red): CD15-negative to dim with low-intermediate side scatter
Lymphocyte gate (green): CD15-negative with lowest side scatter
Scattered ungated events between populations; no GPI-linked marker displayed on this plot
62641.describe_en: Flow cytometry dot plot of CD15 versus side scatter, gated on singlet leukocytes, illustrates the gating strategy for PNH analysis. Granulocytes (blue) are identified as bright CD15-positive events with intermediate to high side scatter, monocytes (red) as CD15-negative to dim events with low-intermediate side scatter, and lymphocytes (green) as CD15-negative events with the lowest side scatter. This plot does not itself demonstrate a PNH clone; the gated granulocytes and monocytes are subsequently evaluated for FLAER and GPI-anchored antigens such as CD24 and CD14.

62577.recognize_zh: H&E：這個視野中可見一個萎縮、玻璃樣變的生發中心，外圍小淋巴球呈同心圓「洋蔥皮」狀排列，並有穿入的小血管，周圍濾泡間區有明顯高內皮小靜脈；屬於類 Castleman 病變的背景變化，本視野未見明顯成群的漿母細胞。
features: Regressed, small germinal center with pale eosinophilic (hyalinized/FDC-rich) core
Concentric 'onion-skin' layering of small mantle zone lymphocytes around the germinal center
Small vessel penetrating toward the follicle center
Interfollicular areas with prominent high endothelial venules and dilated vascular space
Clusters of large plasmablasts not evident in this field
62577.describe_en: Lymph node section shows a follicle with a small, regressed germinal center containing pale eosinophilic material and dendritic cells, surrounded by concentrically layered small mantle zone lymphocytes in an onion-skin pattern, with a vessel penetrating toward the follicle. The interfollicular areas contain prominent high endothelial venules and a dilated vascular space. Clusters of large plasmablastic cells are not evident in this particular field. These Castleman-like changes may be seen in the background of HHV8-positive germinotropic lymphoproliferative disorder, but the diagnostic germinal-center plasmablast aggregates must be identified elsewhere and confirmed with HHV8 LANA-1 and EBER.

ddx.vs: HHV8+ MCD shares regressed follicles with onion-skin mantles but contains scattered EBV-negative LANA-1+ plasmablasts in the mantle zone rather than EBV+ plasmablast clusters in germinal centers.
Unicentric hyaline vascular Castleman disease shows lollipop follicles and twinned germinal centers but lacks HHV8 and plasmablasts.

ddx.dx: Reactive lymphadenopathy with regressed follicles (e.g., HIV-associated)
ddx.vs: HIV-related follicle lysis/regression is HHV8 negative and lacks LANA-1+ plasmablasts, requiring immunostains to separate.

62513.recognize_zh: 活細胞的 CD19 對側向散射（SS）流式圖：綠色圈選的 CD19+、低 SS 小型 B 細胞佔 78.84%，遠多於左下 CD19- 淋巴球與上方高 SS 顆粒球，表示檢體以 B 淋巴球為主，需再以輕鏈與 CD5/CD23 確認 CLL 單株性。
features: Dot plot of CD19-ECD (x-axis) versus side scatter (y-axis) gated on living cells
Gated CD19-positive, low side-scatter population comprising 78.84% of events (green)
CD19 intensity moderate (~10^4), consistent with mature B cells
Minor CD19-negative low side-scatter population (T/NK cells, dark purple)
CD19-negative high side-scatter granulocytes (gray) markedly underrepresented
62513.describe_en: Flow cytometric plot of CD19 versus side scatter on viable cells shows that a CD19-positive, low side-scatter B-cell population comprises 78.84% of events. Smaller populations of CD19-negative lymphocytes and high side-scatter granulocytes are present. This marked B-cell predominance indicates a B-lymphoproliferative process but does not by itself establish clonality. In conjunction with dim monotypic light chain and CD5/CD23 coexpression, the findings are consistent with chronic lymphocytic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Reactive B cells are polytypic for kappa and lambda and rarely constitute such a dominant fraction.
MCL also shows a dominant CD19-positive population but is CD23-negative, FMC7-positive, and cyclin D1-positive.
B-ALL blasts show CD34/TdT expression, dim CD45, and often CD10, rather than a mature sIg-positive phenotype.

62449.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片幾乎被一片中等大小、核型不規則折疊、染色質細緻淡染並可見小核仁的未成熟細胞取代，成熟顆粒球與紅血球前驅細胞很少，其間僅散在少數巨核細胞——符合急性骨髓性白血病的母細胞浸潤。
features: Hypercellular marrow with sheets of intermediate-to-large immature cells effacing normal trilineage hematopoiesis
Irregular, folded to indented nuclear contours with finely dispersed chromatin and small nucleoli
Moderate amounts of pale eosinophilic to amphophilic cytoplasm
Scattered megakaryocytes, including one with a bilobed nucleus, without striking dysplasia
Few maturing granulocytes (occasional eosinophilic granulocytes) and scant erythroid precursors
Fat space at left edge; sinusoidal red cells between the infiltrate
62449.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy (H&E) shows a markedly hypercellular marrow replaced by sheets of intermediate-to-large immature mononuclear cells. The cells have irregular, folded nuclear contours, finely dispersed chromatin, small nucleoli, and moderate pale cytoplasm. Scattered megakaryocytes are present without significant dysplasia, while maturing granulocytic and erythroid elements are markedly reduced. Findings are consistent with involvement by acute myeloid leukemia; enumeration of blasts on the aspirate and immunophenotyping (CD34, CD117, MPO, lysozyme) are required for classification.

ddx.vs: Folded nuclei raise monoblast/promonocyte differentiation, which is confirmed by lysozyme, CD14/CD163 and NSE rather than by H&E alone.
Lymphoblasts typically have scantier cytoplasm and are MPO-negative with TdT, CD19/PAX5 or cytoplasmic CD3 expression.
MDS retains maturing elements with dysplasia and has fewer than 20% blasts, whereas this field is dominated by sheets of blasts.

ddx.dx: Metastatic carcinoma or large cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Cohesive clusters, desmoplasia and keratin positivity or CD20/CD3-positive large lymphoid cells distinguish these from CD34/CD117/MPO-positive myeloblasts.

62385.recognize_zh: 低倍下左側是一大片粉紅色、無細胞結構的地圖狀壞死（geographic necrosis），外圍由淡染、細胞質豐富的組織球帶狀包圍，右側則是保存的深藍紫色淋巴組織；地圖狀壞死加組織球環繞，需以抗酸、GMS 染色排除結核或黴菌感染，並鑑別菊池病。
features: Large geographic area of acellular eosinophilic necrosis
Broad rim of pale histiocytes (foamy/epithelioid) surrounding the necrosis
Sharp demarcation between necrosis, histiocytic zone and viable lymphoid tissue
Viable lymphoid parenchyma with dense lymphocytes on the right
Well-formed hyperplastic follicles not clearly identifiable in this field
62385.describe_en: Low-power view of lymph node shows a large geographic zone of acellular eosinophilic necrosis rimmed by a broad band of pale histiocytes. The histiocytic zone is sharply demarcated from viable, densely cellular lymphoid parenchyma. Hyperplastic follicles referenced in the history are not well visualized in this particular field. The findings represent necrotizing histiocytic lymphadenitis; infectious etiologies (mycobacteria, fungi, cat-scratch disease) should be excluded with special stains and cultures, and Kikuchi-Fujimoto disease considered.

ddx.vs: TB shows caseating granulomas with Langhans giant cells and acid-fast bacilli on Ziehl-Neelsen stain.
Cat-scratch disease forms stellate necrotizing granulomas with central neutrophilic microabscesses and Bartonella on Warthin-Starry or PCR.
Kikuchi necrosis is rich in karyorrhectic debris with crescentic histiocytes and lacks neutrophils and palisading granulomas.
Infarcted lymphoma shows ghost outlines of atypical cells within the necrosis and viable atypical cells at the periphery.

62321.recognize_zh: 四顆中型、圓形母細胞聚在一起，核圓、染色質細緻並有淡染區，周圍一圈稍嗜鹼性（淡藍）細胞質，無 Auer 小體，型態屬未分化母細胞；BPDCN 的母細胞形態不具特異性，要靠免疫表型（CD123、CD4、CD56、TCF4）確認。
features: Cluster of four medium-sized blasts, about 1.5 to 2 times red cell diameter
High N:C ratio with round, regular nuclear contours
Fine to slightly granular chromatin with small indistinct pale nucleolar areas
Thin to moderate rim of slightly basophilic, agranular cytoplasm at this magnification
No Auer rods; vacuoles not clearly seen in these cells
Adjacent small platelet; background red cells unremarkable
62321.describe_en: High-power view of the aspirate smear shows medium-sized blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, round regular nuclei with fine chromatin and indistinct nucleoli, and a thin to moderate rim of slightly basophilic cytoplasm. No Auer rods or definite cytoplasmic granules are seen in this field, and vacuoles are not evident. The morphology is undifferentiated and does not allow lineage assignment. With an immunophenotype of CD4+, CD56+, CD123+ (bright), TCF4+ and lineage-specific markers negative, findings are consistent with blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia (minimally differentiated or monoblastic)
ddx.vs: Morphology overlaps; AML is distinguished by MPO/CD13/CD33/CD117 or monocytic CD14/lysozyme expression and lack of the plasmacytoid dendritic cell TCF4/TCL1/CD123bright profile.
Lymphoblasts express TdT with CD19/CD79a or cytoplasmic CD3 and are CD123/CD56-negative, though TdT can be positive in a subset of BPDCN.

ddx.dx: Acute undifferentiated or mixed-phenotype acute leukemia
ddx.vs: These are defined by flow cytometry lineage marker patterns rather than morphology, and lack the CD4/CD56/CD123 triad.
Blastoid MCL cells are CD19/CD20/CD5 and cyclin D1-positive, not CD123/CD56 plasmacytoid dendritic cells.

62065.recognize_zh: 中倍下可見淋巴組織中有一片細胞核較大、呈卵圓形淡染的上皮樣組織球（epithelioid histiocytes）聚集，周圍環繞小淋巴球，屬於非特異性的反應性變化，需配合螺旋體染色才能指向梅毒。
features: Vaguely nodular aggregate of epithelioid histiocytes with oval to elongated vesicular nuclei and pale eosinophilic cytoplasm
Surrounding cuffs of small, dark, round lymphocytes
Scattered plasma cells and intermediate-sized cells without significant atypia
Occasional small vessels; no necrosis or multinucleated giant cells in this field
Polymorphous reactive composition without monotonous sheets of atypical cells
62065.describe_en: Medium-power H&E section of lymphoid tissue shows a vaguely nodular collection of epithelioid histiocytes with oval vesicular nuclei and pale cytoplasm, surrounded by small mature lymphocytes and occasional plasma cells. No necrosis, multinucleated giant cells, or sheets of cytologically atypical large cells are identified. The appearance is that of a non-specific reactive lymphadenitis with an epithelioid histiocytic component. In the context of syphilitic lymphadenitis these findings are compatible, but they are not specific; Treponema immunostain, special stains for other organisms, and serology are required.

ddx.vs: Toxoplasmosis shows small clusters of epithelioid histiocytes encroaching on reactive germinal centers with monocytoid B-cell hyperplasia, without capsular fibrosis or spirochetes.
These show well-formed granulomas often with caseous necrosis and Langhans giant cells, confirmed by AFB or GMS stains.
NLPHL shows large nodules containing scattered LP (popcorn) cells that are CD20+ and PAX5+, not an epithelioid histiocyte aggregate with bland lymphocytes.
Sarcoidosis has numerous tight non-necrotizing granulomas with giant cells and asteroid bodies, and is a diagnosis of exclusion after organism stains.

62001.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中大量小至中型、核圓、染色質濃密、細胞質少的單一型態細胞密集成片，取代正常造血，只殘留少數巨核細胞與間質；t(11;14) 骨髓瘤的腫瘤漿細胞常呈小型、淋巴球樣（lymphoplasmacytoid）外觀，容易被誤認為小 B 細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Diffuse sheets of monotonous small to medium-sized cells replacing normal hematopoiesis
Round, slightly eccentric nuclei with condensed chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli
Scant to modest pale cytoplasm; plasmacytic features (hof, clock-face chromatin) not well resolved at this magnification
Residual megakaryocytes and interstitial stroma with small vessels
No mitotic-rich large-cell component
62001.describe_en: H&E section of bone marrow shows diffuse sheets of monotonous small to medium-sized cells with round, slightly eccentric nuclei, condensed chromatin and scant to modest cytoplasm, replacing normal hematopoiesis with only residual megakaryocytes and stroma. Definitive plasmacytic features are not clearly resolved at this magnification, and the cells have a lymphoid-like appearance. In the context of CD138-positive, cyclin D1-positive plasma cells with t(11;14), the findings are consistent with extensive involvement by plasma cell myeloma with small, lymphoplasmacytoid morphology, a recognized mimic of small B-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Both can be cyclin D1+ with t(11;14); MCL is CD5+/CD20+/SOX11+ and CD138 negative with surface light chains, whereas myeloma is CD138+ with cytoplasmic light chain restriction.
LPL contains a clonal small B-cell component with MYD88 L265P and IgM paraprotein, and is cyclin D1 negative.
CLL/SLL is CD5+/CD23+/LEF1+ with proliferation centers and lacks CD138 and cyclin D1 expression.

61937.recognize_zh: 低倍淋巴結中央有一個比周圍濾泡大好幾倍的圓形結節，外圈深染的小淋巴球（外套區細胞）向內擴散，使中央生發中心變得模糊、斑駁；旁邊仍有大小正常的反應性濾泡，這是PTGC的典型低倍線索。
features: One markedly enlarged, round nodule several times the size of adjacent follicles
Nodule composed predominantly of small dark lymphocytes with a mottled, ill-defined germinal center
Blurred boundary between mantle zone and germinal center
Adjacent smaller reactive follicles with intact germinal centers and interfollicular high endothelial venules
Background nodal architecture preserved
61937.describe_en: Low-power H&E section of lymph node shows a markedly enlarged round nodule, several times the size of neighboring follicles, composed predominantly of small lymphocytes with a mottled and poorly delineated germinal center. Adjacent follicles are of usual size with preserved germinal centers, and the interfollicular areas and vessels appear unremarkable. Findings are consistent with progressive transformation of germinal centers in a background of reactive follicular hyperplasia.

ddx.dx: Nodular lymphocyte-predominant Hodgkin lymphoma / lymphocyte-predominant B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: NLPHL nodules efface the node and contain scattered large LP (popcorn) cells that are CD20+/OCT2+/BCL6+ and ringed by PD1+ T cells, whereas PTGC lacks LP cells.
FL shows back-to-back uniform follicles with attenuated mantles and BCL2+ germinal centers, rather than a single enlarged nodule among reactive follicles.
MCL shows expanded mantles of cyclin D1+/CD5+ monotonous cells, whereas PTGC mantle cells are IgD+ reactive cells without cyclin D1.

61873.recognize_zh: 腦脊髓液細胞離心抹片中大量原始細胞，核大、染色質細緻，許多細胞的核一側凹陷形成杯狀（cup-like）淡染區，內含細小顆粒，這種杯狀核原始細胞是 NPM1 突變（常合併 FLT3-ITD）AML 的特徵。
features: Numerous large blasts with high to moderate N:C ratio in a CSF cytospin
Fine, dispersed chromatin with small indistinct nucleoli
Cup-like nuclear invaginations forming a pale paranuclear zone containing fine granules
Moderate amount of grey-blue cytoplasm with occasional small vacuoles and cytoplasmic blebs
No Auer rods identified; no normal background cells in this field
61873.describe_en: Cerebrospinal fluid cytospin shows numerous large blasts with fine, dispersed chromatin, small indistinct nucleoli and a moderate amount of grey-blue cytoplasm with occasional vacuoles and blebs. Many blasts display a cup-like nuclear invagination, creating a pale paranuclear zone that contains fine granules and occupies at least a quarter of the nuclear area. No Auer rods are identified and no mature leukocytes are present in this field. In a patient with known relapsed NPM1- and FLT3-mutated AML, findings are consistent with central nervous system involvement by AML with cup-like blasts.

ddx.vs: Microgranular APL shows bilobed or butterfly nuclei, occasional Auer rod bundles, strong MPO and PML::RARA, although cup-like nuclei can occur in APL.
Lymphoblasts have scant agranular cytoplasm without cup-like paranuclear clearing and express B- or T-lineage markers.
Reactive monocytes have folded nuclei with more mature chromatin, abundant vacuolated cytoplasm and a mixed inflammatory background.
Contamination is accompanied by numerous red cells and proportional peripheral leukocytes, whereas this field shows pure blasts without red cells.

61809.recognize_zh: 中倍 H&E 骨髓切片中，骨小樑旁的骨髓腔被單一形態、成片的中型母細胞完全取代，核圓至卵圓、染色質細、可見小核仁，並散在有絲分裂像與凋亡細胞，缺乏正常造血與脂肪，符合 AML 浸潤。
features: Complete replacement of the marrow space by monotonous sheets of intermediate-sized blasts
Round to oval, occasionally indented nuclei with fine chromatin and small nucleoli
Moderate amphophilic cytoplasm with indistinct cell borders
Scattered mitotic figures and apoptotic bodies
Absence of adipocytes and normal trilineage hematopoiesis; bony trabecula at left
61809.describe_en: H&E-stained bone marrow core biopsy shows a packed marrow adjacent to a bony trabecula, with complete replacement of fat and normal hematopoiesis by monotonous sheets of intermediate-sized blasts. The blasts have round to oval, occasionally indented nuclei with fine chromatin, small nucleoli and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm, with scattered mitoses and apoptotic bodies. Maturing erythroid, granulocytic and megakaryocytic elements are not evident in this field. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia in the setting of germline GATA2 mutation; lineage and genetic classification require immunophenotyping, cytogenetics and molecular studies.

ddx.vs: B-ALL blasts are TdT, CD19 and PAX5 positive and MPO negative, which requires IHC or flow to separate from AML.
Lymphoma cells are larger with vesicular chromatin and are CD20/PAX5 positive without myeloid marker expression.
Metastatic tumors form cohesive nests with desmoplasia and express keratin, synaptophysin or other non-hematopoietic markers while lacking CD45.

61745.recognize_zh: H&E 下多形性浸潤，混有小淋巴球、組織球、漿細胞與散在較大的非典型淋巴樣細胞，夾雜大片粉紅色纖維素樣/壞死物質與小血管；這種多形背景加壞死是淋巴瘤樣肉芽腫病（lymphomatoid granulomatosis）的表現，但本視野無法清楚看到血管壁侵犯。
features: Polymorphous infiltrate of small lymphocytes, histiocytes, plasma cells and scattered larger atypical lymphoid cells
Occasional large cells with vesicular nuclei and visible nucleoli within the mixed background
Extensive pale eosinophilic fibrinoid/necrotic material and edematous stroma separating cellular areas
Small blood vessels within the infiltrate; definite transmural angioinvasion is not clearly demonstrated in this field
No well-formed epithelioid granulomas or multinucleated giant cells
61745.describe_en: Sections show a polymorphous lymphohistiocytic infiltrate composed of small lymphocytes, histiocytes and plasma cells with scattered larger atypical lymphoid cells, set within areas of fibrinoid necrosis and edematous stroma. Small vessels are present within the infiltrate, but transmural vascular infiltration is not clearly demonstrated in this field. Well-formed granulomas are absent. In the appropriate clinical context, particularly pulmonary nodules, the findings are consistent with lymphomatoid granulomatosis, with grading dependent on the number of EBER-positive large B cells.

ddx.vs: Shows geographic basophilic necrosis with palisading histiocytes, giant cells and neutrophilic vasculitis, and lacks EBV-positive atypical large B cells (ANCA positive).
Also angiocentric and EBV positive with necrosis, but the atypical cells are CD56+ cytoplasmic CD3+ NK/T cells rather than CD20+ B cells.
Contains CD30+/CD15+/CD20-negative Reed-Sternberg cells with an eosinophil-rich background rather than CD20+ EBV+ large B cells.
Consists of sheets of large atypical B cells without the predominant reactive T-cell background, corresponding to grade 3-like confluent disease.

61681.recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀的 CD45 對側散射（SS）圖，非形態影像；淋巴球閘門佔活細胞 79.66%、顆粒球只有 11.67%，代表明顯的淋巴球增多，其中藍色 AX 族群側散射低但 CD45 表現比正常淋巴球弱。
features: Flow cytometry dot plot, CD45-KO (x-axis, log) versus side scatter intensity (y-axis, linear), gated on [Living Cells]
Lymphs gate containing 79.66% of events versus Grans gate with 11.67%, indicating marked lymphocytosis
Dominant blue population in gate AX with low side scatter and CD45 intensity (about 10^0) lower than the green/magenta lymphocytes
Green/magenta low side scatter population with bright CD45 (about 10^1.5) representing residual normal lymphocytes
Grey high side scatter granulocytes and intermediate side scatter monocytes with moderate CD45
61681.describe_en: Flow cytometric CD45 versus side scatter plot of viable cells shows a predominance of low side scatter events, with the lymphocyte gate comprising 79.66% of events and granulocytes only 11.67%. The dominant low side scatter population (blue, gate AX) displays CD45 intensity lower than the residual normal lymphocytes (green/magenta), which is an unexpected pattern for mature T cells and should be interpreted with caution because fluorochrome brightness, compensation and gating details are not shown. Monocytes and granulocytes are present in their expected regions. The findings document an expanded lymphoid population consistent with the leukemic phase of T-prolymphocytic leukemia, to be characterized by lineage markers on the gated population.

61617.recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓切片可見多個核圓至卵圓、染色質細緻、有小核仁的芽細胞，中央一個小型、核不分葉的巨核細胞，旁邊散見少數分葉嗜中性球與含鐵血黃素，符合 AML 背景下的骨髓切片。
features: Increased immature cells with round to oval nuclei, fine chromatin, and small nucleoli
Moderate pale, slightly vacuolated cytoplasm
Small megakaryocyte with a single round, non-lobated nucleus
Scattered segmented neutrophils and erythroid precursors
Hemosiderin-laden macrophages and adjacent fat spaces
61617.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at high power shows increased immature cells with round to oval nuclei, fine chromatin, small nucleoli, and moderate pale cytoplasm, admixed with scattered segmented neutrophils and erythroid precursors. A small megakaryocyte with a single round non-lobated nucleus is present, and hemosiderin-laden macrophages are noted. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia; blast enumeration by CD34 immunostaining and molecular testing for CEBPA mutation are required, and isolated hypolobated megakaryocytes should prompt evaluation for multilineage dysplasia.

ddx.vs: Requires multilineage dysplasia in ≥50% of cells of ≥2 lineages or MR-defining genetics; a single hypolobated megakaryocyte is insufficient.
MDS-EB has <20% blasts with more preserved dysplastic hematopoiesis; aspirate and CD34 quantitation distinguish.
Plasma cells have eccentric nuclei with coarse clock-face chromatin and a perinuclear hof, and are CD138-positive.

61553.recognize_zh: G 帶核型圖中第 15 與 17 號染色體各有一條被圈起來：一條 15 號長臂較長、一條 17 號長臂變短，代表兩者長臂互換的平衡易位 t(15;17)(q24;q21)，形成 PML::RARA，是急性前骨髓細胞白血病（APL）的定義性異常。
features: G-banded karyotype with 46 chromosomes and XY sex chromosomes (male)
Circled chromosome 15 pair: one homolog with an abnormal, slightly longer long arm, the derivative 15
Circled chromosome 17 pair: one homolog with a shortened, altered long arm, the derivative 17
Reciprocal exchange of 15q and 17q material consistent with t(15;17)(q24;q21)
No marker chromosome or other numerical abnormality in this metaphase
61553.describe_en: This G-banded karyogram from an unstimulated bone marrow culture shows a male metaphase with 46 chromosomes. One chromosome 15 and one chromosome 17 are circled: the derivative chromosome 15 carries additional distal long-arm material, and the derivative chromosome 17 shows a shortened long arm, consistent with a balanced reciprocal translocation 46,XY,t(15;17)(q24;q21). No additional structural or numerical abnormalities are apparent in this cell. This rearrangement generates the PML::RARA fusion and is diagnostic of acute promyelocytic leukemia; FISH or RT-PCR is recommended because cryptic insertions can produce PML::RARA with a normal-appearing karyotype, and to establish a baseline for molecular monitoring.

ddx.dx: APL variant RARA translocations, e.g., t(11;17)(q23;q21) ZBTB16::RARA
ddx.vs: Involve chromosome 11 rather than 15 and are ATRA-resistant, so the partner chromosome must be confirmed.

ddx.dx: Cryptic PML::RARA insertion with normal karyotype
ddx.vs: Karyotype appears normal, but FISH or RT-PCR detects the fusion.
Other recurrent balanced rearrangements involve chromosomes 8/21 or 16, not 15/17.

61425.recognize_zh: 細胞密集的骨髓顆粒邊緣，一顆巨噬細胞胞質內含許多小型卵圓形紫色小體（Leishman-Donovan bodies），周圍為各階段顆粒球前驅細胞，符合利什曼原蟲感染。
features: Cellular marrow fragment edge with a macrophage containing numerous small uniform oval purple organisms around its nucleus
Organisms about 2-4 um, discrete, confined to the pale macrophage cytoplasm
Kinetoplast not clearly resolved at this magnification
Surrounding granulocytic hyperplasia-like field with myelocytes, metamyelocytes and bands, plus an eosinophil precursor
Occasional erythroblasts and lymphocytes
61425.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular field of maturing granulocytic precursors with scattered erythroblasts, lymphocytes and an eosinophilic precursor. Centrally, a macrophage contains numerous small, uniform, oval intracytoplasmic organisms. The nucleus-kinetoplast pair is not clearly resolved at this magnification. Findings are consistent with Leishman-Donovan bodies, supporting visceral leishmaniasis.

ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts show a pericellular clear halo, lack a kinetoplast and are GMS-positive.
Talaromyces yeasts show central septation from fission and no kinetoplast.
Toxoplasma tachyzoites are crescent-shaped with a single nucleus and no kinetoplast.

61361.recognize_zh: 一群細胞具豐富深藍色細胞質、偏心核、部分有核旁淡染區，細胞質內充滿大小一致的透亮圓形空泡，上方大細胞染色質較不成熟，符合骨髓瘤中的非典型漿細胞；形態可似前紅血球母細胞，需免疫表型確認。
features: Cluster of plasma cells with abundant deep blue cytoplasm and eccentric round to oval nuclei
Numerous small uniform clear cytoplasmic vacuoles in several cells
Perinuclear hof visible in some cells; nuclear chromatin ranges from clock-face to more open and immature
Larger atypical cell at top with more dispersed chromatin, resembling a pronormoblast
Central dark-nucleated cell within the cluster and scattered erythrocytes in the background
61361.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows clusters of atypical plasma cells with abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm, eccentric nuclei, focal perinuclear hofs and numerous clear cytoplasmic vacuoles. Some cells have more dispersed immature chromatin and resemble erythroid precursors. The cohesive clustering and cytologic atypia favor a neoplastic plasma cell population. Findings are consistent with involvement by plasma cell myeloma, to be confirmed by CD138 and kappa/lambda light chain restriction and correlation with serum/urine paraprotein studies.

ddx.vs: Pronormoblasts have round central nuclei with fine chromatin, deeply blue cytoplasm without a Golgi hof or vacuoles, and are CD71/E-cadherin positive but CD138 negative.
Reactive plasma cells are mature, scattered or perivascular, polytypic for kappa and lambda, and lack immature chromatin or sheets.
Carcinoma clusters are more cohesive with nuclear molding and are cytokeratin positive and CD138 variable but light-chain negative.
Shows a spectrum of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with MYD88 L265P and usually IgM paraprotein.

61297.recognize_zh: CD34 染色將竇狀血管內皮勾勒成細棕線，可見大型巨核細胞與成群紅血球前驅細胞位於擴張的竇狀血管內（intrasinusoidal hematopoiesis）；巨核細胞本身為陰性、核深染且形態不規則，符合纖維化期骨髓增殖性腫瘤。
features: CD34-positive endothelium outlining dilated, anastomosing sinusoids
Large CD34-negative megakaryocytes with hyperchromatic, irregular nuclei within sinusoidal lumens
Clusters of erythroid precursors located inside sinusoids
Scattered CD34-positive small mononuclear cells, not forming clusters
Cellular marrow with adipocytes
61297.describe_en: CD34 immunohistochemistry on the bone marrow core biopsy highlights prominent, dilated sinusoids lined by CD34-positive endothelium. Within the sinusoidal lumens are large megakaryocytes with hyperchromatic, irregular nuclei and groups of erythroid precursors, consistent with intrasinusoidal hematopoiesis. CD34-positive blasts are scattered and not clustered in this field. In the context of known polycythemia vera, findings are consistent with post-polycythemic myelofibrosis; reticulin and trichrome stains are needed to grade fibrosis.

ddx.vs: PMF shows identical intrasinusoidal hematopoiesis and cloud-like megakaryocytes, so separation from post-PV myelofibrosis requires the documented prior PV history.
This is also morphologically indistinguishable at the fibrotic stage and is separated by clinical history and often CALR or JAK2 status.

ddx.dx: Accelerated or blast phase of MPN
ddx.vs: Progression would show clusters or sheets of CD34-positive blasts reaching 10% or more, rather than scattered single cells.

61233.recognize_zh: S100 免疫染色讓淋巴結竇內的大型組織球整顆染成棕色，細胞質內包著多顆完整、未染色的小淋巴球（呈空心圓圈樣），這種 S100 陽性加上胞吞淋巴球（emperipolesis）就是 Rosai-Dorfman 病的典型表現。
features: Numerous large histiocytes with strong cytoplasmic and nuclear S100 positivity
Intact S100-negative lymphocytes within histiocyte cytoplasm, appearing as clear 'holes' outlined by brown staining (emperipolesis)
Positive histiocytes aggregated in expanded sinus-like zones
Background small lymphocytes negative for S100
Granular brown debris and weakly stained smaller histiocytes around the large cells
61233.describe_en: S100 immunohistochemistry on a lymph node section highlights numerous large histiocytes with strong nuclear and cytoplasmic staining, clustered within expanded sinus-like areas. Many histiocytes contain multiple intact, unstained lymphocytes within their cytoplasm, sharply outlined by the S100-positive cytoplasm, demonstrating emperipolesis. The surrounding small lymphocytes are negative. Findings are consistent with Rosai-Dorfman disease (sinus histiocytosis with massive lymphadenopathy); the histiocytes are typically also CD68/CD163 positive and CD1a/langerin negative.

ddx.vs: Langerhans cells are also S100 positive but have grooved coffee-bean nuclei, lack emperipolesis and are CD1a and langerin positive.
Sinus histiocytes are S100 negative or only weakly positive and do not show prominent emperipolesis.
Melanoma cells are S100 positive but show nuclear atypia, macronucleoli and SOX10/HMB45/Melan-A expression, without engulfed lymphocytes.

61169.recognize_zh: 組合圖中骨髓切片可見大型、細胞質豐富淡染、細胞核不規則或雙葉的非典型肥大細胞，CD117 膜狀、tryptase 強陽性、CD25 陽性；抹片（G–I）中是充滿紫色顆粒、體積大的非典型肥大細胞，背景另有 CD19/LEF1 陽性的 CLL 小淋巴球，符合合併 CLL 的肥大細胞白血病。
features: Panels A/B (H&E): hypercellular infiltrate with large atypical mast cells having abundant pale to clear cytoplasm, distinct borders and irregular, bilobed or multilobed nuclei
Panel C: CD19/LEF1 double stain highlights a dense population of small lymphoid cells (CLL component) between the large cells
Panel D: CD117 strong membranous staining of the large atypical cells
Panel E: tryptase strong cytoplasmic positivity in numerous mast cells
Panel F: weak to moderate membranous CD25 expression in the mast cells
Panels G-I (aspirate): large round mast cells with abundant purple metachromatic granules, some with hypogranular areas, eccentric or bilobed nuclei (promastocyte/atypical forms)
61169.describe_en: This composite shows marrow involvement by a dense infiltrate of large atypical mast cells with abundant pale cytoplasm and irregular, bilobed to multilobed nuclei, admixed with a population of small lymphocytes. Immunohistochemistry shows the large cells to be CD117 (membranous) and tryptase positive with aberrant CD25 expression, while a CD19/LEF1 double stain highlights the small lymphoid cells of chronic lymphocytic leukemia. Aspirate smears show numerous large, round atypical mast cells with dense metachromatic granules and focal hypogranularity, including immature forms. Findings are consistent with mast cell leukemia (aleukemic, given the context) with an associated hematologic neoplasm, here CLL and CMML; mast cell percentage on the aspirate (at least 20%) and KIT D816V testing support the diagnosis.

ddx.dx: Systemic mastocytosis (non-leukemic) with associated hematologic neoplasm
ddx.vs: SM-AHN has compact spindle mast cell aggregates with fewer than 20% mast cells on the aspirate, whereas mast cell leukemia shows at least 20% round atypical mast cells on smears.
Myelomastocytic leukemia occurs in advanced myeloid neoplasms with metachromatic blasts and immature mast cells that lack SM criteria such as compact aggregates, CD25 expression or KIT D816V.
Basophils have segmented nuclei and water-soluble granules and are CD123/CD203c positive but tryptase weak and CD117 negative.
Reactive mast cells are scattered, round to spindle, well granulated and CD25/CD2 negative, without sheets or atypia.

61169.stain: H&E, Wright-Giemsa, IHC: CD19/LEF1, CD117, tryptase, CD25

61105.recognize_zh: 周邊血可見多顆中小型淋巴球，核圓、染色質濃密、細胞質少而深藍，部分有細胞質突起；心肌切片中淋巴球沿心肌纖維間浸潤並伴隨心肌細胞破壞，免疫染色顯示浸潤細胞為 T 細胞，代表 T-PLL 侵犯心臟。
features: PB (A): increased small to medium lymphocytes with round to slightly irregular nuclei, condensed chromatin and scant deeply basophilic cytoplasm; one cell with a cytoplasmic bleb
Nucleoli not resolvable at this image resolution
Heart (B): dense perivascular and interstitial lymphoid infiltrate dissecting between cardiomyocytes
Myocyte injury with separation and loss of fibers adjacent to the infiltrate
IHC (C-E): infiltrating cells strongly positive for T-cell-associated markers (antigens not labeled), in interstitial and perivascular distribution
61105.describe_en: Composite figure. The peripheral blood smear shows an increase in small to medium-sized lymphocytes with round nuclei, condensed chromatin, scant basophilic cytoplasm and occasional cytoplasmic blebs; nucleoli cannot be assessed at this resolution. Sections of myocardium show a dense perivascular and interstitial lymphoid infiltrate dissecting between and damaging cardiomyocytes. Immunostains label the infiltrating cells in the same interstitial distribution, consistent with a T-cell phenotype. Findings are consistent with cardiac involvement by T-cell prolymphocytic leukemia, with the clinical correlate of heart failure.

ddx.vs: Myocarditis contains a polyclonal mixed T-cell infiltrate without a concurrent leukemic population, TCL1 expression or clonal TRA/TRB rearrangement.
ATLL cells have polylobated flower-shaped nuclei, are CD25 positive and HTLV-1 associated.
Sezary cells have cerebriform nuclei and a history of erythroderma, and are TCL1 negative.
CLL cells are B cells (CD19, CD20 dim, CD23, CD5) with soccer-ball chromatin and smudge cells.

61041.recognize_zh: 高倍下可見成群、胞質透明且核稍不規則的中型非典型細胞，圍繞在內皮細胞肥厚的高內皮小靜脈旁，並混有免疫母細胞、組織球、漿細胞及有絲分裂像，符合 AITL 的透明細胞群聚。
features: Clusters of medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells with abundant clear cytoplasm and distinct cell borders
Irregular nuclei with vesicular to moderately condensed chromatin
High endothelial venules with plump endothelial cells and hyalinized walls
Admixed immunoblasts with prominent nucleoli, histiocytes and plasma cells
Scattered mitotic figures and apoptotic bodies; extravasated red cells
61041.describe_en: High-power view of lymph node shows clusters of medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells with abundant clear cytoplasm and irregular nuclei, arranged around high endothelial venules with plump endothelium. The background is polymorphous, containing immunoblasts, epithelioid histiocytes and plasma cells, with scattered mitotic figures. Findings are consistent with angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma, to be confirmed by TFH immunophenotype and T-cell receptor clonality.

ddx.vs: PTCL-NOS lacks a consistent TFH immunophenotype and the characteristic clear-cell clusters around proliferating HEVs.
Scattered large cells in TCRBCL are CD20+ B cells, whereas AITL clear cells are CD3+/PD-1+ T cells.
Reactive proliferations lack aggregates of atypical clear T cells and are polyclonal by TCR studies.

60977.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中可見兩大團深藍色細菌：一團散在細胞外、落在破碎的淡染細胞質殘骸上，另一團密集堆在嗜中性球內；周圍嗜中性球細胞質明顯空泡化並含細小顆粒，代表嚴重菌血症。本圖菌體多呈短棒狀／成對排列，單憑 Wright 染色無法確認是否為題目所稱的葡萄球菌。
features: Two dense aggregates of small, deeply basophilic bacteria between and within leukocytes
Upper aggregate: bacteria lying on a smudged, pale cytoplasmic remnant, appearing largely extracellular
Lower aggregate: tightly packed bacteria within a neutrophil with vacuolated cytoplasm
Organisms appear as short rods/coccobacilli and paired forms rather than clearly spherical clusters
Several neutrophils with prominent cytoplasmic vacuolization and fine granular debris (toxic change, degeneration)
Red cells unremarkable apart from mild anisocytosis
60977.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous small, darkly basophilic bacteria forming two aggregates, one lying free on disrupted cytoplasmic debris and one packed within a neutrophil. Adjacent neutrophils show marked cytoplasmic vacuolization with fine granular debris, in keeping with phagocytosis and cell degeneration. On Wright-Giemsa stain the organisms appear as short rods or paired coccoid forms; morphology on a Romanowsky-stained smear cannot reliably distinguish cocci from coccobacilli or identify species, so correlation with Gram stain and blood culture (reported as Staphylococcus capitis) is essential. Findings are consistent with overwhelming bacteremia with both free and phagocytosed organisms.

ddx.vs: Contaminants lie in a different focal plane, are not phagocytosed and are not accompanied by neutrophil vacuolization; blood culture confirms true bacteremia.
Platelets show granular centers and variable size, and stain precipitate is refractile and irregular, unlike uniform discrete bacterial bodies.
Fungi are larger (2-5 µm), oval with budding or a clear halo, compared with these tiny uniform bacteria.
Morulae are single mulberry-like inclusions within an intact vacuole rather than large numbers of discrete free and intracellular organisms.

60913.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中聚集成群的大型細胞，細胞質深藍且有小空泡、細胞彼此黏附；切片為成片的圓形藍細胞，免疫染色呈細胞核陽性（肌源性標記），流式顯示 CD45 陰性、CD56 陽性，細胞遺傳與 FISH 顯示 FOXO1 相關轉位，符合轉移性腺泡型橫紋肌肉瘤。
features: Aspirate: cohesive clusters of large cells with high N:C ratio, round nuclei, fine chromatin and deeply basophilic, finely vacuolated cytoplasm
Biopsy: diffuse sheets of monotonous small round blue cells replacing marrow
IHC: strong nuclear staining in the majority of tumor cells (consistent with myogenin/MyoD1)
Flow cytometry: 98.9% of events CD45-negative/CD56-positive; only 0.6% CD45+CD14+ cells
Metaphase karyotype/FISH images with arrows marking translocation partners and interphase break-apart pattern (1R1G1F) versus normal (2F)
60913.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate contains cohesive clusters of large tumor cells with round nuclei, fine chromatin, high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio and deeply basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm, which could be mistaken for leukemic blasts. The trephine is diffusely replaced by sheets of small round blue cells, which show strong nuclear immunoreactivity with a myogenic transcription factor stain. Flow cytometry shows that nearly all events are CD45-negative and CD56-positive.
