Non-destructive PTLD preserves the underlying architecture, whereas polymorphic PTLD effaces it.

62129.recognize_zh: 淋巴結濾泡間區中央可見一團密集、胞質鮮紅的嗜酸性球聚集成嗜酸性微膿瘍（eosinophilic microabscess），周圍是小淋巴球、內皮細胞明顯的小血管與少量組織球，這是木村病（Kimura disease）的重要線索。
features: Dense central aggregate of eosinophils with bright red cytoplasmic granules forming a microabscess
Surrounding interfollicular infiltrate of small mature lymphocytes
Scattered eosinophils also dispersed in the adjacent interfollicular tissue
Associated histiocytes/epithelioid cells and small vessels with plump endothelium around the aggregate
No atypical large cells or Reed-Sternberg-like cells identified in this field
62129.describe_en: Lymph node section shows an interfollicular area containing a well-circumscribed aggregate of eosinophils forming an eosinophilic microabscess, surrounded by histiocytes and small vessels. The background consists of small mature lymphocytes with additional scattered eosinophils. No atypical large lymphoid cells, Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells, or granulomas with necrosis are identified. In the setting of florid follicular hyperplasia, peripheral eosinophilia, and elevated IgE, findings are consistent with Kimura disease.

ddx.vs: ALHE is a dermal/subcutaneous vascular lesion with epithelioid (histiocytoid) endothelial cells protruding into lumens, lacking the nodal follicular hyperplasia and IgE deposits of Kimura disease.
CHL contains CD30+/CD15+ Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells within the eosinophil-rich background, which are not seen here.
LCH shows sheets of Langerhans cells with grooved nuclei that are CD1a, langerin, and S100 positive, often in sinuses.
These may produce eosinophilic infiltrates but lack the characteristic IgE-coated germinal centers and vascular proliferation, and history or organism identification is decisive.

60465.recognize_zh: 中倍率下可見被細纖維帶分隔的模糊結節，結節內幾乎全為大型中心母細胞（centroblasts），核泡狀、有貼近核膜的多個核仁，看不到中心細胞的混雜，符合濾泡性淋巴瘤 3B 級。
features: Vaguely nodular (follicular) architecture delineated by thin collagen bands
Nodules composed almost entirely of large cells with vesicular chromatin
Multiple small nucleoli, often located adjacent to the nuclear membrane (centroblasts)
Moderate pale eosinophilic cytoplasm with distinct cell borders and occasional retraction halos
Scarce small cleaved centrocytes; scattered mitoses and apoptotic bodies
Small lymphocytes more evident between nodules at the periphery
60465.describe_en: Section shows a vaguely nodular proliferation separated by thin fibrous bands. The nodules are composed of sheets of large centroblasts with round to oval vesicular nuclei, multiple membrane-bound nucleoli, and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm, with virtually no admixed centrocytes. Mitotic figures and apoptotic bodies are present, and small lymphocytes are seen in the internodular areas. Diffuse areas cannot be excluded on this single field and should be assessed, as they would warrant a diagnosis of DLBCL. Findings are consistent with follicular lymphoma, grade 3B.

ddx.vs: DLBCL lacks follicular architecture; any diffuse area of large cells in FL grade 3 is reported as DLBCL.
Grade 3A retains admixed centrocytes along with more than 15 centroblasts per HPF, whereas 3B consists of solid sheets of centroblasts.
Reactive follicles show polarization, tingible-body macrophages, mantle zones, and BCL2-negative germinal centers, with a mixture of centrocytes and centroblasts.
Pleomorphic MCL is cyclin D1 and SOX11 positive and CD10 negative.

2929.recognize_zh: 周邊血液低倍視野中，中央兩顆嗜中性球被一圈聚集的血小板環繞貼附（platelet satellitism），而背景其他區域游離血小板很少；這是 EDTA 引起的體外假性血小板減少，改用檸檬酸抗凝管重抽即可確認。
features: Two neutrophils in the center surrounded by a rosette of adherent platelets
Platelets are normal-sized and clustered around and on the neutrophil membranes
Few free platelets elsewhere in the field
Additional neutrophil with associated platelets at the top edge
Background red cells unremarkable at this low magnification
2929.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low power shows neutrophils rimmed by numerous adherent platelets, forming platelet satellites, with relatively few free platelets in the background. The red cells are unremarkable at this magnification, and no platelet clumps unrelated to leukocytes are evident in this field. This phenomenon is an in vitro artifact mediated by EDTA-dependent antibodies and causes falsely low automated platelet counts. Findings are consistent with EDTA-induced platelet satellitism (pseudothrombocytopenia); a repeat count in citrate or heparin anticoagulant is recommended.

ddx.vs: True thrombocytopenia shows a genuinely sparse platelet population without platelets adhering to neutrophils or clumping, and the count is low in citrate tubes as well.
Clumping forms free platelet aggregates, often at the feathered edge, rather than rosettes around neutrophils, though both cause pseudothrombocytopenia.
Phagocytosed platelets lie within the neutrophil cytoplasm in vacuoles, whereas satellitism shows platelets adhering to the outer cell surface.
